quest.title: Sealed Site of Sacrifice
quest.description: Find and stabilize the Astral Assemblage(s) to activate the Celestial Axis at the center of the Sacred City...

talks.objective: Break the seal over the Astral Assemblage(s)

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The scene materializes before you like some nostalgic memory.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text:
Operations stream along countless convolutions, flowing spectrum paths that shift across layered platforms.
The accumulated Phlogiston coalesces under immense pressure into a floating, controllable ball of heat.
"We've done it!" Your brethren cheer all around you.
Yet the one who masterminded this feat, in no way inferior to star-forging, stands outside the experimental site, as though wholly unrelated to this momentous deed.

dialogues.speaker: Cold Voice
dialogues.text: Congratulations are in order. Creating something equivalent to a celestial body in miniature... An "Astral Assemblage," is it? Truly, a grand achievement, comparable with lunar reconstruction.

dialogues.speaker: Cold Voice
dialogues.text: "That one" would surely have tucked their wings in and nodded congratulations to you — were they still with us.

dialogues.speaker: Somber Yet Weary Voice
dialogues.text: "...If you had been willing to help, it might have been completed long ago."

dialogues.speaker: Cold Voice
dialogues.text: I have no interest in it.

dialogues.speaker: Somber Yet Weary Voice
dialogues.text: "...But you should help me, Kukulkan. We have driven the All-Plunderer's herald into the deepest of mountain valleys, yet once its master awakens..."

dialogues.speaker: Somber Yet Weary Voice
dialogues.text: "It will surely bring another catastrophe upon our people."

dialogues.speaker: Cold Voice
dialogues.text: Ah, how very noble of you, creating this thing to protect your pitiable brethren...

dialogues.speaker: Somber Yet Weary Voice
dialogues.text: "'Our' pitiable brethren."

dialogues.speaker: Somber Yet Weary Voice
dialogues.text: "This is only the beginning, and my days are numbered. I must forge a new path for the Dragonborn before the pitch-black shadow smothers us all."

dialogues.speaker: Cold Voice
dialogues.text: Or, perhaps, you should let them find their own way... Forgive my forthrightness, but the path you plan to create may be too narrow for our kind.

dialogues.speaker: Somber Yet Weary Voice
dialogues.text: "The narrow way must be walked. When your time runs short... When waiting becomes a luxury."

dialogues.speaker: Somber Yet Weary Voice
dialogues.text: "Enough waiting, I say. A time will come, Kukulkan, when your days go down like the sun behind the hills, and you will understand. Then, you shall make the same decision as I have..."

dialogues.speaker: Cold Voice
dialogues.text: ...My king, my elder brother, O lord who gave me life on the day you yourself were born... On this alone I cannot concede to you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. That... Did we just see something that happened when this fireball was made?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You saw that too, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, Paimon saw it super clearly this time as well... The ones surrounding this cake platform had to be the dragons who used to live here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But who were the two people who were speaking, then? Weird...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Graawrr...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, the seal on the Astral Assemblage here should be broken now, right?
